meta.prompt: Show me the flights from London to Lisbon this Friday (20 Nov) as an inline card I can pick from. There are two of us flying, 2 adults, and the prices are per person. Three direct options: TAP Air Portugal 07:15 to 09:50, 2h 35m, £128, tagged Best time; easyJet 11:40 to 14:20, 2h 40m, £84, tagged Cheapest; British Airways 18:05 to 20:40, 2h 35m, £156. The first one is selected to start, the total is for both of us and follows my choice, and the confirm button tells you which flight I chose.
meta.text:
ChatCard "Choose your flight" "London to Lisbon, Fri 20 Nov, 2 adults" icon:"flight" status:"3 direct" tone:accent
  state pick="tap"
  state sel=0
  SectionLabel "Flights" "per person"
  FlightOption "TAP Air Portugal" depart:"07:15" arrive:"09:50" origin:"LHR" destination:"LIS" duration:"2h 35m" stops:"Direct" price:"£128" tag:"Best time" selected:=pick=="tap" -> pick="tap"; sel=128
  FlightOption "easyJet" depart:"11:40" arrive:"14:20" origin:"LHR" destination:"LIS" duration:"2h 40m" stops:"Direct" price:"£84" tag:"Cheapest" selected:=pick=="easy" -> pick="easy"; sel=84
  FlightOption "British Airways" depart:"18:05" arrive:"20:40" origin:"LHR" destination:"LIS" duration:"2h 35m" stops:"Direct" price:"£156" selected:=pick=="ba" -> pick="ba"; sel=156
  TotalBar "Total for 2 adults" "return not included" amount:=money(sel*2,"£",0) cta:"Confirm" icon:"check" enabled:=sel>0 -> emit confirm pick
